an10.87:1.1: [sāvatthi] tatra kho bhagavā kalandakaṃ bhikkhuṃ ārabbha bhikkhū āmantesi
an10.87:2.1: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu adhikaraṇiko hoti, adhikaraṇasamathassa na vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:2.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu adhikaraṇiko hoti, adhikaraṇasamathassa na vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo na piyattāya na garuttāya na bhāvanāya na sāmaññāya na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu na sikkhākāmo hoti, sikkhāsamādānassa na vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:3.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu na sikkhākāmo hoti, sikkhāsamādānassa na vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo na piyattāya na garuttāya na bhāvanāya na sāmaññāya na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu pāpiccho hoti, icchā vinayassa na vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:4.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu pāpiccho hoti, icchāvinayassa na vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo na piyattāya na garuttāya na bhāvanāya na sāmaññāya na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu kodhano hoti, kodhavinayassa na vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:5.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu kodhano hoti, kodhavinayassa na vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo na piyattāya …pe… na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu makkhī hoti, makkha vinayassa na vaṇṇavādī,
an10.87:6.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu makkhī hoti, makkhavinayassa na vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo na piyattāya …pe… na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave saṭho hoti, sāṭheyya vinayassa na vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:7.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu saṭho hoti, sāṭheyyavinayassa na vaṇṇavādī ayampi dhammo na piyattāya …pe… na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu māyāvī hoti, māyāvinayassa na vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:8.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu māyāvī hoti, māyāvinayassa na vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo na piyattāya …pe… na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:9.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammānaṃ na nisāmakajātiyo hoti dhamma nisantiyā na vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:9.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammānaṃ na nisāmakajātiyo hoti, dhamma nisantiyā na vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo na piyattāya …pe… na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:10.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu na paṭisallāno hoti, paṭisallānassa na vaṇṇavādī
an10.87:10.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu na paṭisallāno hoti, paṭisallānassa na vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo na piyattāya …pe… na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:11.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ na paṭisanthārako hoti, paṭisanthārakassa na vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:11.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu na paṭisanthārako hoti, paṭisanthārakassa na vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo na piyattāya, na garuttāya na bhāvanāya na sāmaññāya na ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:12.1: evarūpassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno kiñcāpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
an10.87:12.2: ‘aho vata maṃ sabrahmacārī sakkareyyuṃ garukareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyunti’. atha kho naṃ sabrahmacārī na ceva sakkaronti, na garukaronti, na mānenti, na pūjenti,
an10.87:12.4: tathā hissa bhikkhave viññū sabrahmacārī te pāpake akusale dhamme appahīne samanupassanti.
an10.87:13.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave assakhaluṅkassa kiñcāpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
an10.87:13.2: aho vata maṃ manussā ājānīyaṭṭhāne ṭhapeyyuṃ, ājānīyabhojanañca bhojeyyuṃ, ājānīyaparimajjanañca parimajjeyyunti”. atha kho naṃ manussā na ceva ājānīyaṭṭhāne ṭhapenti, na ca ājānīyabhojanaṃ bhojenti, na ca ājānīyaparimajjanaṃ parimajjanti.
an10.87:13.4: tathā hissa bhikkhave viññū manussā tāni sāṭheyyāni, kūṭeyyāni jimbheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni appahīnāni samanupassanti.
an10.87:13.5: evameva kho bhikkhave evarūpassa bhikkhuno kiñcāpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
an10.87:13.6: “aho vata maṃ sabrahmacārī sakkareyyuṃ garukareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyunti”. atha kho naṃ sabrahmacārī na ceva sakkaronti, na garukaronti, na mānenti, na pūjenti.
an10.87:13.8: tathā hissa bhikkhave viññū sabrahmacārī te pāpake akusale dhamme appahīne samanupassanti.
an10.87:14.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu na adhikaraṇiko hoti, adhikaraṇasamathassa vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:14.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu na adhikaraṇiko hoti, adhikaraṇasamathassa vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo piyattāya garuttāya bhāvanāya sāmaññāya ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:15.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhākāmo hoti, sikkhāsamādānassa vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:15.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhākāmo sikkhāsamādānassa vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo piyattāya …pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:16.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu appiccho hoti, icchā vinayassa vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:16.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu appiccho hoti, icchāvinayassa vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo piyattāya …pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:17.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu akkodhano hoti, kodhavinayassa vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:17.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu akkodhano hoti, kodhavinayassa vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo piyattāya …pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:18.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu amakkhī hoti, makkhavinayassa vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:18.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu amakkhī hoti, makkhavinayassa vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo piyattāya …pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:19.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu asaṭho hoti, sāṭheyya vinayassa vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:19.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu asaṭho hoti, sāṭheyyavinayassa vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo piyattāya …pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:20.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu amāyāvī hoti, māyāvinayassa vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:20.2: yampi bhikkhave amāyāvī hoti, māyāvinayassa vaṇṇavādī ayampi dhammo piyattāya …pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:21.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammānaṃ nisāmakajātiyo hoti, dhammanisantiyā vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:21.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammānaṃ nisāmakajātiyo hoti, dhammanisantiyā vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo piyattāya …pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:22.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisallīno hoti, paṭisallānassa vaṇṇavādī,
an10.87:22.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisallīno hoti, paṭisallānassa vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo piyattāya …pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:23.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ paṭisanthārako hoti, paṭisanthārakassa vaṇṇavādī.
an10.87:23.2: yampi bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisanthārako hoti, paṭisanthārakassa vaṇṇavādī, ayampi dhammo piyattāya garuttāya bhāvanāya, sāmaññāya ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
an10.87:24.1: evarūpassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno kiñcāpi na evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya,
an10.87:24.2: “aho vata maṃ sabrahmacārī sakkareyyuṃ garukareyyuṃ, māneyyuṃ pūjeyyunti”. atha kho naṃ sabrahmacārī sakkaronti, garukaronti, mānenti, pūjenti,
an10.87:24.4: tathā hissa bhikkhave viññū sabrahmacārī te pāpake akusale dhamme pahīne samanupassanti.
an10.87:25.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave bhaddassa assājānīyassa kiñcāpi na evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
an10.87:25.2: “aho vata maṃ manussā ājānīyaṭṭhāne ṭhapeyyuṃ ājānīyabhojananañca bhojeyyuṃ, ājānīyaparimajjanañca parimajjeyyunti”, atha kho naṃ manussā ājānīyaṭṭhāne ṭhapenti, ājānīyabhojanañca bhojentī, ājānīyaparimajjanañca parimajjanti.
an10.87:25.4: tathā hissa bhikkhave viññū manussā tāni sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni pahīnāni samanupassanti.
an10.87:26.1: evameva kho bhikkhave evarūpassa bhikkhuno kiñcāpi na evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
an10.87:26.2: “aho vata maṃ sabrahmacārī sakkareyyuṃ, garukareyyuṃ, māneyyuṃ, pūjeyyunti”, atha kho naṃ sabrahmacārī sakkaronti, garukaronti, mānenti, pūjenti
an10.87:26.4: tathā hissa bhikkhave viññū sabrahmacārī te pāpake akusale dhamme pahīne samanupassantīti.
